dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh, so this is what bards from Liyue are like, Kaeya?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: That's right. Very different from those of Mondstadt, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Taking Klee out on one of your jaunts, Kaeya?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Strictly speaking, the Spark Knight and I are here on official business, investigating the wine industry export situation in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Studying the consumption of Mondstadt's liquor requires visiting the performance venues where it is consumed. Enjoying the arts of Liyue while we're at it is part and parcel of our work.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Isn't that right, Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I—Is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Of course it is. Just enjoy the show to your heart's content!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Sure! This "Liyue Opera" is so much fun!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Classic Kaeya, leading the youth astray...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: #Why, {NICKNAME}, I see you've come to Heyu Tea House again... Oh, are you with friends?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is Captain Kaeya from Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And this is the Spark Knight, Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And this is Yun Jin, a professional opera performer from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: An honor to meet you, Ms. Yun. I've heard many traveling merchants speak of the art form you practice.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: This is the first time Klee and I have had the pleasure of watching an opera. A fascinating experience, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah! Also, could you teach Klee how you spin your spear like that?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm glad you enjoyed yourselves. As for "spear flourishes," I'm afraid they can be quite difficult to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Klee will do her best!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Well, seeing how interested you are, come see me after the performance, while our troupe is resting.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: There are some smaller spears I used to train with when I was a child, let me find one to teach you with.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Then you have my thanks, Ms. Yun. Ahem... Spark Knight Klee, do you remember what the Knights of Favonius Handbook says?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yes, Kaeya— Oh! I mean, Yes, Captain Kaeya!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: In that case, when a distinguished guest does you a kindness, how should you respond?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Thank you very much, kind-hearted... Uh... lady who sings Liyue opera!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Haha, you're too kind, both of you. You're here to watch the opera, so I'm sure this meeting was meant to be. I look forward to seeing you in the audience in the future, should you have the time.
